about_the_game:
In Last Fuse, your greatest weapon is also your greatest threat. Build a nuclear bomb in the heart of a city, using its energy to power defenses against relentless alien attacks. But tapping into its power pushes it closer to meltdown. Manage crazy engineers, balance scarce resources, and push the limits with risky upgrades like bomb overdrive. Research alien tech, make high-stakes decisions, and fight to survive the chaos.

The Bomb: Your Power and Your Doom

The bomb is your greatest asset, but also your greatest threat. It generates energy to power your defenses, but the more you use it, the hotter it gets. Manage its heat carefully, or you’ll push it to meltdown.

Overclock your bomb for more energy, take bigger risks, and power up your defenses - but let the heat max out, and your city won’t be standing for long.

Defend Against Relentless Alien Attacks

They’re coming. They won’t stop. Set up turrets, upgrade your defenses, and hold the line - all while keeping your bomb from turning your city into a crater.

Build the Bomb, Gather Resources, Stay Alive.

Steel, titanium, coolant...every resource counts. Manage your economy, balance construction speed with energy needs, and prepare for the inevitable.

Harness alien technology for upgrades.

Research permanent upgrades that make each subsequent run easier.

Choose Your Bomb, Choose Your Fate

From the icy Frostcore to the volatile Overdrive Reactor, each bomb comes with unique perks and challenges. Will you harness controlled power or risk total meltdown for greater rewards?

Dynamic weather

Blinding storms, eerie nights, scorching heat...weather isn’t just for show. It affects visibility, energy production, and even your defenses. Adapt or perish.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual core 3 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual core 3 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A tower defense with a twist - you’re defending a nuclear bomb. It powers your defenses, but the more you use it, the closer you get to meltdown. Manage chaotic engineers, scarce resources and risky upgrades - every decision counts.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
